description: This file manages the malfunction indicator light (MIL) for a vehicle, including blinking patterns for error codes, displaying error codes via blink sequences, and managing the thread that continuously monitors and displays error codes. It includes functions for initializing the indicator, testing the indicator, and showing error codes according to the OBD-II standard.

methods.name: blink_digits
methods.description: Blinks the specified number of times with a given duration for each blink, used to display individual digits of the error code.

methods.name: DigitLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits in an integer error code.

methods.name: DisplayErrorCode
methods.description: Displays the vehicle error code as a sequence of blinks, representing each digit.

methods.name: mfiThread
methods.description: Main thread function that periodically retrieves and displays error codes via blinking patterns.

methods.name: testMil
methods.description: Adds sample error codes for testing the malfunction indicator display.

methods.name: isMilEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the malfunction indicator pin is configured and enabled.

methods.name: initMalfunctionIndicator
methods.description: Initializes the malfunction indicator system, creates the display thread, and sets up console commands.
